title: 林克时间 · 画面设置

strength.behavior: cycle on activation; immediate native save at integration

layout.heightStress: guiHeight<210: hide optional contextual help, scroll only options; header/global hint/Done remain available
layout.nativeRounding: Use integer bounds and native font metrics; tested preview uses integer button widths in target modes

nativeReuse.font: Minecraft default font; browser substitutes system font
nativeReuse.buttons: Existing native Button/CycleButton behavior and normal widget appearance; browser uses beveled flat approximation
nativeReuse.brand: Reuse adopted A14 PNG as header identifier
nativeReuse.procedural: Panel fill, thin border, labels, state text and dividers
nativeReuse.layoutGuideSvg: Editable geometry reference; not a production raster asset

behaviorContract.entry: Existing F8 binding and original key-rebind route
behaviorContract.save: Preserve current immediate update/save; do not add save/cancel semantics
behaviorContract.close: Done/Esc returns to parent; preview shows placeholder only
behaviorContract.strengthOff: All five toggles remain editable and preferences retained; visual output suppressed; time/stamina/sounds unaffected
behaviorContract.scope: Six existing fields only; no equipment-transition toggle, sound slider or gameplay controls
behaviorContract.help: Static descriptive help on hover/focus; no flashing/animated demo
behaviorContract.prototypeStorage: Memory only; no actual game config writes or persistent local storage

localization: Existing labels retained; short help/overview prose supplied in ui-copy-proposal.json; use project language provider/datagen on integration

referenceLimits.historicalBackground: Unmodified A11 historical world frame; background composition not runtime screenshot
referenceLimits.previewDoesNotApplyFocusEffects: Settings page interaction illustrates stored preferences, not a running effect or skill
referenceLimits.prototypeSizeStress: 320x180 is a layout stress reference, not a claim about native Minecraft minimum GUI size
